links.outcome: Reading level and content retention of LLM-simplified patient information versus 6th-grade target
links.effect: ChatGPT improved readability but did not reach the recommended 6th-grade level. Bard reached 6th-grade level but omitted up to 83% of the content.
links.quote: Bard reached the reading level of 6th graders but oversimplified the texts by omitting up to 83% of the content.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to rewrite existing patient information materials to a lower reading level

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLMs (ChatGPT and Bard) on simplifying patient education materials and measuring reading level and content omission.
